title: Manual Typed Tools Reliability Queue
purpose: Repair Dakkshin manual typed-tool reliability through the AE Agent roadmap supervisor with existing AO-inspired support gates, without installing or running any external AO runtime.

sourceContext.executionModel: Sequential roadmap supervisor items, one roadmap-sdk writer child at a time, two read-only reviewers in parallel, validation before auto-commit, handoff after each item, and generated-only live acceptance only for M219.
sourceContext.productMilestoneDecision: Use product milestones M216 through M219 because the work repairs runtime, planner, semantic verification, and panel/live acceptance behavior.

aoPipelineUsage.failurePolicy: Analyzer packets classify failures and feed bounded next-task routing only; no analyzer auto-fix is allowed.
